# Hoducation Technologies
> Enterprise Custom Software Engineering, Institutional ERPs, and AI Assessment Automation

Hoducation Technologies Pvt Ltd is an enterprise technology provider based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. We engineer mission-critical custom software, multi-branch ERP systems, CRM pipelines, and AcadOS—our flagship 5-in-1 institutional EdTech platform with AI question paper generation and computer-vision smartphone OMR scanning.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- **Custom Software Engineering**: Bespoke web applications, microservices, and internal administrative tools with strict security and high concurrency.
- **Enterprise ERP Systems**: Unified campus management automating admissions, student records, fee collection, staff payroll, inventory, and multi-branch operations.
- **CRM & Admissions Hub**: High-velocity lead lifecycle systems with automated WhatsApp & SMS triggers and zero lead leakage.
- **AcadOS (Institutional Assessment OS)**: Automated question paper generation in <60 seconds, smartphone computer-vision OMR grading (99.8% precision), and NTA-grade CBT exam simulators.
- **Intelligent Automations & AI**: Agentic workflow automation, background RPA, and intelligent document processing.
